title: CS8391 – DATA STRUCTURES
description:
UNIT I – ALGORITHM ANALYSIS & ARRAYS
Introduction to Data Structures. Definition and characteristics of algorithms. Performance analysis of algorithms. Time complexity and space complexity. Asymptotic notations – Big O, Big Omega and Big Theta. Best, worst and average case analysis. Linear search and binary search. Definition of array. One dimensional, two dimensional and multidimensional arrays. Sparse matrix representation. Applications of arrays.

UNIT II – STACK & QUEUE
Definition of stack. Stack operations. Stack implementation using array and linked list. Applications of stack – recursion, infix to postfix conversion, postfix expression evaluation, parenthesis checking. Definition of queue. Simple queue, circular queue, deque and priority queue. Queue implementation using array and linked list. Applications of queue.

UNIT III – LINKED LIST
Definition of linked list. Singly linked list. Doubly linked list. Circular linked list. Insertion and deletion operations for all types of linked lists. Polynomial representation and manipulation using linked lists. Applications of linked lists.

UNIT IV – TREES & GRAPH
Tree terminology. Binary tree representation. Binary search tree. Tree traversals – inorder, preorder and postorder. Heap. Balanced trees. Introduction to graphs. Graph representations. Graph traversals – breadth first search and depth first search. Applications of trees and graphs.

UNIT V – SORTING, HASHING & FILE STRUCTURE
Sorting techniques – bubble sort, selection sort, insertion sort, merge sort, quick sort and heap sort. Hashing concepts. Hash functions. Collision handling techniques – open addressing and chaining. File structure concepts. Sequential file organization and direct access files.

title: OPTICAL COMMUNICATION NETWORK ENGINEERING
description:
UNIT I – INTRODUCTION TO OPTICAL FIBERS

Basics of optical communication

Advantages over copper communication

Types of optical fibers: step-index, graded-index, single mode, multimode

Light propagation in fibers

Numerical aperture, acceptance angle

Attenuation, dispersion, bending losses

Fiber materials and fabrication methods

Fiber cables and structure

UNIT II – OPTICAL SOURCES AND DETECTORS

Optical sources: LEDs, LASER diodes

Characteristics: P–I curves, modulation response, quantum efficiency

Optical detectors: PIN diode, Avalanche Photodiode (APD)

Detector performance: responsivity, noise, sensitivity

Optical transmitter design

Optical receiver design

UNIT III – OPTICAL LINK DESIGN & ANALYSIS

Link power budget and rise-time budget

System considerations: BER, SNR, receiver sensitivity

Couplers, connectors, splices – types and characteristics

Wavelength filters, isolators, circulators

Optical amplifiers: EDFA, Raman amplifier, semiconductor optical amplifier

UNIT IV – OPTICAL NETWORK COMPONENTS

WDM technology: CWDM, DWDM

Multiplexers and demultiplexers

Optical add–drop multiplexers (OADM)

Reconfigurable optical add–drop multiplexers (ROADM)

Optical switches and cross-connects

Optical network protection: 1+1, 1:1, ring protection

UNIT V – OPTICAL NETWORK ARCHITECTURES & PROTOCOLS

SONET / SDH network architecture

Optical transport network (OTN) basics

Passive Optical Networks (PON): EPON, GPON

FTTH system design

Optical packet switching

Optical burst switching

Routing and wavelength assignment (RWA)

Emerging trends: elastic optical networks, space-division multiplexing, photonic integrated circuits
